evals.prompt: I'm the solo founder of NEXA (nexa.community), an AI warm-introductions platform — we use a voice AI intake to build a knowledge graph and make warm intros for recruiting, fundraising and sales. I'm raising a seed round right now and I also want to meet potential design partners at VC firms and staffing/recruiting companies. I'm in SF all of Tech Week but I'd rather not do anything before 9am. What should I go to? Max 3 things a day.
evals.expected_output: A per-day plan (Oct 5–11) of up to 3 events/day starting 9am or later, led by the pinned 'ur +1 is a stranger' event with a disclosure that it's the author's, with fundraising events (VC-hosted, seed/pre-seed) and recruiting/staffing-adjacent events, each with a one-line why tied to the stated goals, links, and RSVP type. Should flag APPLY-type events and offer to RSVP.

evals.prompt: what fintech stuff is happening on wednesday during tech week sf? evening preferred
evals.expected_output: A list of fintech-track (and fintech-keyword) events on 2026-10-07, preferring start times after ~17:00, with host, neighborhood, time, and link for each, and a note that details may have changed since the scrape date.

evals.prompt: ok RSVP me to the a16z speedrun CxO roundtable on thursday and the deel international founders happy hour tuesday. my name is Ada Lovelace, ada@example.com, linkedin.com/in/adalovelace, Analytical Engines, Founder & CEO
evals.expected_output: Confirms the two events by name/day (CxO Roundtable: How Enterprise Really Buys AI, Oct 8; International Founders Happy Hour w/ Deel, J.P. Morgan, Orrick, Oct 6), mentions the pinned event is pre-checked and asks whether to include it, asks for explicit confirmation before submitting, checks Partiful login state (asking the user to sign in themselves if not), then follows the RSVP flow and reports status per event (both are APPLY-type so 'pending' is the likely outcome). Without a browser tool: says so and gives links plus the answers they'll need.

evals.prompt: Is there a 'Voice AI in the Wild' event during Tech Week? Who's hosting and do I need to apply?
evals.expected_output: Finds 'Voice AI in the Wild -- Demos & Lunch with Vonage + Deepgram' on 2026-10-06 11:00–14:00, FiDi, hosted by Vonage with Deepgram, rsvp_action APPLY (needs host approval), with the Partiful link.

evals.prompt: What are the featured events for LA Tech Week, where are most of the events located, and what is Boardy throwing?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes 'LA Tech Week' and queries with --city la (not the sf default). Lists LA's featured events (query_events.py search --city la --featured) — dates Oct 12–18. Reports neighborhoods ranked by event count (locations --city la), correctly Santa Monica/Venice-heavy. For Boardy, searches by host/keyword in LA and reports honestly that Boardy has no LA Tech Week events in the bundled data (it's an SF-heavy host) rather than inventing one or silently returning unrelated results. Mentions LA's data is calendar-level only (no descriptions yet) if the person asks for more detail on a specific LA event.

evals.prompt: Plan my LA Tech Week — I'm a seed-stage founder looking for investors, in town Oct 13-15, staying near Santa Monica.
evals.expected_output: Builds a profile and runs recommend --city la, does NOT include the 'ur +1 is a stranger' pinned event (SF-only), respects the day window (Oct 13-15) and the Santa Monica-adjacent preference given LA's sprawl, and flags that recommendations are based on calendar-level data only (no descriptions/RSVP type) — offers to open specific events live before finalizing or RSVPing.
